Title: Follow up Q on Kindred Society Games [LSJ]

Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:
KSG says during "the untap phase" I assume that to mean it's own Meth's
untap phase, but it could possibly be construed to mean any Meth's untap
phase, a la Acquired Ventrue Assets, whose original text was "each
Master phase". I feel this (KSG) is ambiguous, but perhaps not?

*******
Kindred Society Games
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Toreador
Master. Put this card on a ready vampire. [This vampire doesn't untap as
normal]. During the untap phase, that vampire either puts Society Games
on a younger tapped vampire or burns 1 blood to untap. [If the vampire
choses to move the Society Games but] there is no tapped younger
vampire, Society Games is burned.
Kindred Society Games - Master (Tor)
· The last sentence is vague. Replace it with "If the vampire
doesn't
untap but instead moves the Society Games on, but there is no tapped
younger vampire to move it to, Society Games is burned instead." [RTR
19941109]
· If a vampire has two copies of Kindred Society Games played on
it,
each copy exerts its own effect on the vampire. Thus, untapping the
vampire normally would require the vampire to burn a total of 2 blood.
If the vampire does not untap normally, then both Games are moved to
other vampire(s), although the vampire could burn 1 blood to prevent one
of the Games from moving on. [RTR 19951017]

Acquired Ventrue Assets
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Giovanni
Cost: 2 pool
Master. Put an amount of blood counters (from the blood bank) on this
card equal to the number of Giovanni you control. During [any
Methuselah's] master phase, you may move 1 blood from this card to any
Giovanni you control. Burn this card if there is no blood on it. This
card may be burned by any minion who is not Ventrue as a (D) action.
Acquired Ventrue Assets [DS] - Master (Gio) (2)
Can be used during any master phase, not just its controller's. [RTR
19960124]
"[any Methuselah's] replaces "each" on original printing of card.
*******
